daisy.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: the attached original 5x5 numbered label-border design sheet. design 07, second row second column: extract ONLY the complete small daisy and leaf cluster at the top left corner. Preserve the large daisy, small blossoms, and little trailing leaves. Remove the rounded rectangular frame. Faithfully extract and clean up this original illustration, preserving its original silhouette, proportions, expressive details and black ink line style; do not redesign it. Deliver ONE isolated high-resolution transparent PNG with clean antialiased black strokes, tightly framed with a small even transparent margin. Remove all text, numbers, unrelated art and every bit of the label frame. All white background, including white interior regions of the line drawing, must become genuinely transparent. No baseline, surrounding box, gray background, checkerboard pixels, color, shadows or extra objects.
